observed.caption: Shoppers browse art and craft stalls under a large corrugated metal roof in a covered open-air market.
observed.description: A wide covered market hall with a corrugated metal roof supported by dark green steel beams and columns, with white pendant lights hanging from the ceiling. The concrete floor has yellow painted lines. Numerous market stalls line the sides and center, displaying framed paintings, textiles, clothing and various crafts. A group of people is gathered on the left examining framed artwork, while other individuals are walking, standing and browsing throughout the hall. Daylight enters from the open sides of the structure. The scene is viewed from ground level across the interior of the market.
